name: Illiyana
summary: Near the Shrine of Aessina, Illiyana keeps watch over the woods of southwestern Ashenvale. The ancient dryad protects the woodland from corruption and calls on Alliance champions to drive back the satyrs.

sections.title: Daughter of the Forest
sections.body: Illiyana patrols the woods of southwestern Ashenvale as one of Cenarius's daughters. Dryads live in peace, yet fiercely defend wild lands. As corruption spreads through the woodland, Illiyana guards sacred relics and groves, keeping watch over nature's primal sanctity.

sections.title: The Threat of the Satyr
sections.body: Satyrs remain a threat to the glades and Illiyana's dryad sisters. These twisted, demonic creatures seek to corrupt the woods. Illiyana calls on travelers to slay them and recover lost relics, including the Branch of Cenarius, so the woodland stays free of demonic taint.

faq.answer: Illiyana is a dryad who patrols southwestern Ashenvale near the Shrine of Aessina. A daughter of Cenarius, she watches over the wildlands and protects her sisters from demonic forces.

faq.q: Why does Illiyana keep walking while I talk to her?
faq.answer: Illiyana keeps to an active patrol route through the woodland. She continues pacing the grove while speaking with travelers.
Illiyana calls on travelers to hunt the satyrs menacing the region and recover sacred relics such as the Branch of Cenarius to protect her fellow dryads.
Illiyana patrols near the Shrine of Aessina in southwestern Ashenvale, watching the paths and nearby groves.

faq.q: Why are the dryads in danger from satyrs?
faq.answer: Satyrs are ancient night elves warped by demonic corruption. They delight in defiling nature and subjugating Cenarius's children, making dryads targets of their malice.
No. Illiyana is allied with the Night Elves and the Alliance. Horde members who enter her glade will find her and her allies hostile.

angles.text: For the Kaldorei, dryads like Illiyana are sacred kin of Cenarius and protectors of the wild. Their call to arms against demonic satyrs is answered without hesitation.
Druids honor dryads as embodiments of the wild. Helping Illiyana preserve the sanctified glades serves the Cenarion duty to heal the land.
Illiyana is a woodland ally in southwestern Ashenvale. She offers shelter and guidance to Alliance forces protecting the wilderness from encroaching evils.
